78.en: About what are they asking one another
About the great news
That over which they are in disagreement
No! They are going to know
Then, no! They are going to know
Have We not made the earth a resting place
And the mountains as stakes
And We created you in pairs
And made your sleep [a means for] rest
And made the night as clothing
And made the day for livelihood
And constructed above you seven strong [heavens]
And made [therein] a burning lamp
And sent down, from the rain clouds, pouring water
That We may bring forth thereby grain and vegetation
And gardens of entwined growth
Indeed, the Day of Judgement is an appointed time

78.ar: يَوۡمَ يُنفَخُ فِي ٱلصُّورِ فَتَأۡتُونَ أَفۡوَاجٗا
78.en: The Day the Horn is blown and you will come forth in multitudes
And the heaven is opened and will become gateways
And the mountains are removed and will be [but] a mirage
Indeed, Hell has been lying in wait
For the transgressors, a place of return
In which they will remain for ages [unending]

78.ar: لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرۡدٗا وَلَا شَرَابًا
78.en: They will not taste therein [any] coolness or drink
Except scalding water and [foul] purulence
An appropriate recompense
Indeed, they were not expecting an account
And denied Our verses with [emphatic] denial
But all things We have enumerated in writing
So taste [the penalty], and never will We increase you except in torment
Indeed, for the righteous is attainment
Gardens and grapevines
And full-breasted [companions] of equal age
And a full cup

78.ar: لَّا يَسۡمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغۡوٗا وَلَا كِذَّـٰبٗا
78.en: No ill speech will they hear therein or any falsehood
[As] reward from your Lord, [a generous] gift [made due by] account

78.ar: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِۖ لَا يَمۡلِكُونَ مِنۡهُ خِطَابٗا
78.en: [From] the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Most Merciful. They possess not from Him [authority for] speech

78.ar: يَوۡمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ صَفّٗاۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنۡ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابٗا
78.en: The Day that the Spirit and the angels will stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits, and he will say what is correct

78.ar: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمُ ٱلۡحَقُّۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
78.en: That is the True Day; so he who wills may take to his Lord a [way of] return

78.ar: إِنَّآ أَنذَرۡنَٰكُمۡ عَذَابٗا قَرِيبٗا يَوۡمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلۡمَرۡءُ مَا قَدَّمَتۡ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلۡكَافِرُ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي كُنتُ تُرَٰبَۢا
78.en: Indeed, We have warned you of a near punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust

79.en: By those [angels] who extract with violence
And [by] those who remove with ease
And [by] those who glide [as if] swimming
And those who race each other in a race
And those who arrange [each] matter
On the Day the blast [of the Horn] will convulse [creation]
There will follow it the subsequent [one]
Hearts, that Day, will tremble
Their eyes humbled
They are [presently] saying, "Will we indeed be returned to [our] former state [of life]
Even if we should be decayed bones
They say, "That, then, would be a losing return
Indeed, it will be but one shout
And suddenly they will be [alert] upon the earth's surface
Has there reached you the story of Moses

79.ar: إِذۡ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلۡوَادِ ٱلۡمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
79.en: When his Lord called to him in the sacred valley of Tuwa
Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed

79.ar: فَقُلۡ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ
79.en: And say to him, 'Would you [be willing to] purify yourself
And let me guide you to your Lord so you would fear [Him]
And he showed him the greatest sign
But Pharaoh denied and disobeyed
Then he turned his back, striving
And he gathered [his people] and called out
And said, "I am your most exalted lord
So Allah seized him in exemplary punishment for the last and the first [transgression]

79.ar: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبۡرَةٗ لِّمَن يَخۡشَىٰٓ
79.en: Indeed in that is a warning for whoever would fear [Allah]

79.ar: ءَأَنتُمۡ أَشَدُّ خَلۡقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُۚ بَنَىٰهَا
79.en: Are you a more difficult creation or is the heaven? Allah constructed it
He raised its ceiling and proportioned it
And He darkened its night and extracted its brightness
And after that He spread the earth
He extracted from it its water and its pasture
And the mountains He set firmly
As provision for you and your grazing livestock
But when there comes the greatest Overwhelming Calamity
The Day when man will remember that for which he strove
And Hellfire will be exposed for [all] those who see
So as for he who transgressed
And preferred the life of the world
Then indeed, Hellfire will be [his] refuge

79.ar: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفۡسَ عَنِ ٱلۡهَوَىٰ
79.en: But as for he who feared the position of his Lord and prevented the soul from [unlawful] inclination
Then indeed, Paradise will be [his] refuge
They ask you, [O Muhammad], about the Hour: when is its arrival
In what [position] are you that you should mention it
To your Lord is its finality
You are only a warner for those who fear it

79.ar: كَأَنَّهُمۡ يَوۡمَ يَرَوۡنَهَا لَمۡ يَلۡبَثُوٓاْ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوۡ ضُحَىٰهَا
79.en: It will be, on the Day they see it, as though they had not remained [in the world] except for an afternoon or a morning thereof

80.en: The Prophet frowned and turned away
Because there came to him the blind man, [interrupting]
But what would make you perceive, [O Muhammad], that perhaps he might be purified
Or be reminded and the remembrance would benefit him
As for he who thinks himself without need
To him you give attention
And not upon you [is any blame] if he will not be purified
But as for he who came to you striving [for knowledge]
While he fears [Allah]
From him you are distracted
No! Indeed, these verses are a reminder
So whoever wills may remember it
[It is recorded] in honored sheets
Exalted and purified
[Carried] by the hands of messenger-angels
Noble and dutiful
Cursed is man; how disbelieving is he
From what substance did He create him
From a sperm-drop He created him and destined for him
Then He eased the way for him
Then He causes his death and provides a grave for him
Then when He wills, He will resurrect him
No! Man has not yet accomplished what He commanded him
Then let mankind look at his food
How We poured down water in torrents
Then We broke open the earth, splitting [it with sprouts]
And caused to grow within it grain
And grapes and herbage
And olive and palm trees
And gardens of dense shrubbery
And fruit and grass
[As] enjoyment for you and your grazing livestock
But when there comes the Deafening Blast
On the Day a man will flee from his brother
And his mother and his father
And his wife and his children

80.ar: لِكُلِّ ٱمۡرِيٕٖ مِّنۡهُمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٖ شَأۡنٞ يُغۡنِيهِ
80.en: For every man, that Day, will be a matter adequate for him
[Some] faces, that Day, will be bright
Laughing, rejoicing at good news
And [other] faces, that Day, will have upon them dust
Blackness will cover them
Those are the disbelievers, the wicked ones

81.en: When the sun is wrapped up [in darkness]
And when the stars fall, dispersing
And when the mountains are removed
And when full-term she-camels are neglected
And when the wild beasts are gathered
And when the seas are filled with flame
And when the souls are paired
And when the girl [who was] buried alive is asked
For what sin she was killed
And when the pages are made public
And when the sky is stripped away
And when Hellfire is set ablaze
And when Paradise is brought near
A soul will [then] know what it has brought [with it]
So I swear by the retreating stars
Those that run [their courses] and disappear
And by the night as it closes in
And by the dawn when it breathes
[That] indeed, the Qur'an is a word [conveyed by] a noble messenger

81.ar: ذِي قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِي ٱلۡعَرۡشِ مَكِينٖ
81.en: [Who is] possessed of power and with the Owner of the Throne, secure [in position]
Obeyed there [in the heavens] and trustworthy
And your companion is not [at all] mad
And he has already seen Gabriel in the clear horizon
And Muhammad is not a withholder of [knowledge of] the unseen
And the Qur'an is not the word of a devil, expelled [from the heavens]
So where are you going
It is not except a reminder to the worlds
For whoever wills among you to take a right course

81.ar: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
81.en: And you do not will except that Allah wills - Lord of the worlds

82.en: And when the stars fall, scattering
And when the seas are erupted
And when the [contents of] graves are scattered
A soul will [then] know what it has put forth and kept back

82.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلۡكَرِيمِ
82.en: O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous
Who created you, proportioned you, and balanced you

82.ar: فِيٓ أَيِّ صُورَةٖ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
82.en: In whatever form He willed has He assembled you
No! But you deny the Recompense
And indeed, [appointed] over you are keepers
Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure
And indeed, the wicked will be in Hellfire
They will [enter to] burn therein on the Day of Recompense
And never therefrom will they be absent
And what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense

82.ar: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا يَوۡمُ ٱلدِّينِ
82.en: Then, what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense

82.ar: يَوۡمَ لَا تَمۡلِكُ نَفۡسٞ لِّنَفۡسٖ شَيۡـٔٗاۖ وَٱلۡأَمۡرُ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلَّهِ
82.en: It is the Day when a soul will not possess for another soul [power to do] a thing; and the command, that Day, is [entirely] with Allah

83.en: Woe to those who give less [than due]

83.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكۡتَالُواْ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسۡتَوۡفُونَ
83.en: Who, when they take a measure from people, take in full
But if they give by measure or by weight to them, they cause loss
Do they not think that they will be resurrected
For a tremendous Day
The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds

83.ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلۡفُجَّارِ لَفِي سِجِّينٖ
83.en: No! Indeed, the record of the wicked is in sijjeen
And what can make you know what is sijjeen
It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed
Woe, that Day, to the deniers
Who deny the Day of Recompense

83.ar: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعۡتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
83.en: And none deny it except every sinful transgressor

83.ar: إِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
83.en: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples

83.ar: كَلَّاۖ بَلۡۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ
83.en: No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning

83.ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمۡ عَن رَّبِّهِمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لَّمَحۡجُوبُونَ
83.en: No! Indeed, from their Lord, that Day, they will be partitioned
Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire

83.ar: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
83.en: Then it will be said [to them], "This is what you used to deny

83.ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارِ لَفِي عِلِّيِّينَ
83.en: No! Indeed, the record of the righteous is in 'illiyyun
And what can make you know what is 'illiyyun
It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed
Which is witnessed by those brought near [to Allah]
Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure
On adorned couches, observing
You will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure
They will be given to drink [pure] wine [which was] sealed

83.ar: خِتَٰمُهُۥ مِسۡكٞۚ وَفِي ذَٰلِكَ فَلۡيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلۡمُتَنَٰفِسُونَ
83.en: The last of it is musk. So for this let the competitors compete
And its mixture is of Tasneem
A spring from which those near [to Allah] drink

83.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجۡرَمُواْ كَانُواْ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ يَضۡحَكُونَ
83.en: Indeed, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed
And when they passed by them, they would exchange derisive glances

83.ar: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓاْ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُواْ فَكِهِينَ
83.en: And when they returned to their people, they would return jesting

83.ar: وَإِذَا رَأَوۡهُمۡ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
83.en: And when they saw them, they would say, "Indeed, those are truly lost
But they had not been sent as guardians over them

83.ar: فَٱلۡيَوۡمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مِنَ ٱلۡكُفَّارِ يَضۡحَكُونَ
83.en: So Today those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers
On adorned couches, observing

83.ar: هَلۡ ثُوِّبَ ٱلۡكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُواْ يَفۡعَلُونَ
83.en: Have the disbelievers [not] been rewarded [this Day] for what they used to do

84.en: When the sky has split [open]
And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]
And when the earth has been extended
And has cast out that within it and relinquished [it]
And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]

84.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدۡحٗا فَمُلَٰقِيهِ
84.en: O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord with [great] exertion and will meet it
Then as for he who is given his record in his right hand
He will be judged with an easy account
And return to his people in happiness

84.ar: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهۡرِهِۦ
84.en: But as for he who is given his record behind his back
He will cry out for destruction
And [enter to] burn in a Blaze
Indeed, he had [once] been among his people in happiness
Indeed, he had thought he would never return [to Allah]

84.ar: بَلَىٰٓۚ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرٗا
84.en: But yes! Indeed, his Lord was ever of him, Seeing
So I swear by the twilight glow
And [by] the night and what it envelops
And [by] the moon when it becomes full
[That] you will surely experience state after state
So what is [the matter] with them [that] they do not believe

84.ar: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانُ لَا يَسۡجُدُونَۤ۩
84.en: And when the Qur'an is recited to them, they do not prostrate [to Allah]
But those who have disbelieved deny
And Allah is most knowing of what they keep within themselves
So give them tidings of a painful punishment

84.ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمۡ أَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُونِۭ
84.en: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds. For them is a reward uninterrupted

85.en: By the sky containing great stars
And [by] the promised Day
And [by] the witness and what is witnessed
Cursed were the companions of the trench
[Containing] the fire full of fuel
When they were sitting near it

85.ar: وَهُمۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفۡعَلُونَ بِٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ شُهُودٞ
85.en: And they, to what they were doing against the believers, were witnesses

85.ar: وَمَا نَقَمُواْ مِنۡهُمۡ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤۡمِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡحَمِيدِ
85.en: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy

85.ar: ٱلَّذِي لَهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ شَهِيدٌ
85.en: To whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And Allah, over all things, is Witness

85.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُواْ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمۡ يَتُوبُواْ فَلَهُمۡ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابُ ٱلۡحَرِيقِ
85.en: Indeed, those who have tortured the believing men and believing women and then have not repented will have the punishment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the Burning Fire

85.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمۡ جَنَّـٰتٞ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡكَبِيرُ
85.en: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds will have gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great attainment
Indeed, the vengeance of your Lord is severe
Indeed, it is He who originates [creation] and repeats
And He is the Forgiving, the Affectionate
Honorable Owner of the Throne
Effecter of what He intends
Has there reached you the story of the soldiers
[Those of] Pharaoh and Thamud
But they who disbelieve are in [persistent] denial
While Allah encompasses them from behind
But this is an honored Qur'an
[Inscribed] in a Preserved Slate

86.en: By the sky and the night comer
And what can make you know what is the night comer

86.ar: إِن كُلُّ نَفۡسٖ لَّمَّا عَلَيۡهَا حَافِظٞ
86.en: There is no soul but that it has over it a protector
So let man observe from what he was created
He was created from a fluid, ejected
Emerging from between the backbone and the ribs
Indeed, Allah, to return him [to life], is Able
The Day when secrets will be put on trial

86.ar: فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٖ وَلَا نَاصِرٖ
86.en: Then man will have no power or any helper
And [by] the earth which cracks open
Indeed, the Qur'an is a decisive statement
Indeed, they are planning a plan
But I am planning a plan
So allow time for the disbelievers. Leave them awhile

87.en: Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High
And who brings out the pasture
We will make you recite, [O Muhammad], and you will not forget

87.ar: إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَعۡلَمُ ٱلۡجَهۡرَ وَمَا يَخۡفَىٰ
87.en: Except what Allah should will. Indeed, He knows what is declared and what is hidden
And We will ease you toward ease
So remind, if the reminder should benefit
He who fears [Allah] will be reminded
But the wretched one will avoid it
[He] who will [enter and] burn in the greatest Fire

87.ar: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحۡيَىٰ

87.en: He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself
And mentions the name of his Lord and prays
But you prefer the worldly life
While the Hereafter is better and more enduring
Indeed, this is in the former scriptures
The scriptures of Abraham and Moses

88.en: Has there reached you the report of the Overwhelming [event]
[Some] faces, that Day, will be humbled
Working [hard] and exhausted
They will [enter to] burn in an intensely hot Fire
They will be given drink from a boiling spring

88.ar: لَّيۡسَ لَهُمۡ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعٖ
88.en: For them there will be no food except from a poisonous, thorny plant

88.ar: لَّا يُسۡمِنُ وَلَا يُغۡنِي مِن جُوعٖ
88.en: Which neither nourishes nor avails against hunger
[Other] faces, that Day, will show pleasure
With their effort [they are] satisfied
In an elevated garden
Wherein they will hear no unsuitable speech
Within it is a flowing spring
Within it are couches raised high
And cups put in place
And cushions lined up
And carpets spread around

88.ar: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلۡإِبِلِ كَيۡفَ خُلِقَتۡ
88.en: Then do they not look at the camels - how they are created
And at the sky - how it is raised
And at the mountains - how they are erected
And at the earth - how it is spread out
So remind, [O Muhammad]; you are only a reminder
You are not over them a controller
However, he who turns away and disbelieves
Then Allah will punish him with the greatest punishment
Indeed, to Us is their return
Then indeed, upon Us is their account

89.en: By the dawn
And [by] ten nights
And [by] the even [number] and the odd
And [by] the night when it passes

89.ar: هَلۡ فِي ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمٞ لِّذِي حِجۡرٍ
89.en: Is there [not] in [all] that an oath [sufficient] for one of perception

89.ar: أَلَمۡ تَرَ كَيۡفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ
89.en: Have you not considered how your Lord dealt with 'Aad
[With] Iram - who had lofty pillars

89.ar: ٱلَّتِي لَمۡ يُخۡلَقۡ مِثۡلُهَا فِي ٱلۡبِلَٰدِ
89.en: The likes of whom had never been created in the land
And [with] Thamud, who carved out the rocks in the valley
And [with] Pharaoh, owner of the stakes
[All of] whom oppressed within the lands
And increased therein the corruption
So your Lord poured upon them a scourge of punishment
Indeed, your Lord is in observation

89.ar: فَأَمَّا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبۡتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكۡرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّيٓ أَكۡرَمَنِ
89.en: And as for man, when his Lord tries him and [thus] is generous to him and favors him, he says, "My Lord has honored me

89.ar: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبۡتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيۡهِ رِزۡقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّيٓ أَهَٰنَنِ
89.en: But when He tries him and restricts his provision, he says, "My Lord has humiliated me
No! But you do not honor the orphan
And you do not encourage one another to feed the poor
And you consume inheritance, devouring [it] altogether
And you love wealth with immense love

89.ar: كَلَّآۖ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ دَكّٗا دَكّٗا
89.en: No! When the earth has been leveled - pounded and crushed
And your Lord has come and the angels, rank upon rank

89.ar: وَجِاْيٓءَ يَوۡمَئِذِۭ بِجَهَنَّمَۚ يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ
89.en: And brought [within view], that Day, is Hell - that Day, man will remember, but what good to him will be the remembrance
He will say, "Oh, I wish I had sent ahead [some good] for my life
So on that Day, none will punish [as severely] as His punishment
And none will bind [as severely] as His binding [of the evildoers]
[To the righteous it will be said], "O reassured soul
Return to your Lord, well-pleased and pleasing [to Him]
And enter among My [righteous] servants
And enter My Paradise

90.en: I swear by this city, Makkah
And you, [O Muhammad], are free of restriction in this city
And [by] the father and that which was born [of him]
We have certainly created man into hardship

90.ar: أَيَحۡسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقۡدِرَ عَلَيۡهِ أَحَدٞ
90.en: Does he think that never will anyone overcome him
He says, "I have spent wealth in abundance
Does he think that no one has seen him
Have We not made for him two eyes
And a tongue and two lips
And have shown him the two ways
But he has not broken through the difficult pass
And what can make you know what is [breaking through] the difficult pass
It is the freeing of a slave

90.ar: أَوۡ إِطۡعَٰمٞ فِي يَوۡمٖ ذِي مَسۡغَبَةٖ
90.en: Or feeding on a day of severe hunger
An orphan of near relationship
Or a needy person in misery

90.ar: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلصَّبۡرِ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلۡمَرۡحَمَةِ
90.en: And then being among those who believed and advised one another to patience and advised one another to compassion
Those are the companions of the right

90.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا هُمۡ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَشۡـَٔمَةِ
90.en: But they who disbelieved in Our signs - those are the companions of the left
Over them will be fire closed in

91.en: By the sun and its brightness
And [by] the moon when it follows it
And [by] the day when it displays it
And [by] the night when it covers it
And [by] the sky and He who constructed it
And [by] the earth and He who spread it
And [by] the soul and He who proportioned it
And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness
He has succeeded who purifies it
And he has failed who instills it [with corruption]
Thamud denied [their prophet] by reason of their transgression
When the most wretched of them was sent forth

91.ar: فَقَالَ لَهُمۡ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقۡيَٰهَا
91.en: And the messenger of Allah [Salih] said to them, "[Do not harm] the she-camel of Allah or [prevent her from] her drink

91.ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمۡدَمَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمۡ فَسَوَّىٰهَا
91.en: But they denied him and hamstrung her. So their Lord brought down upon them destruction for their sin and made it equal [upon all of them]
And He does not fear the consequence thereof

92.en: By the night when it covers
And [by] the day when it appears
And [by] He who created the male and female
Indeed, your efforts are diverse
As for he who gives and fears Allah
And believes in the best [reward]
We will ease him toward ease
But as for he who withholds and considers himself free of need
And denies the best [reward]
We will ease him toward difficulty

92.ar: وَمَا يُغۡنِي عَنۡهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ
92.en: And what will his wealth avail him when he falls
Indeed, [incumbent] upon Us is guidance
And indeed, to Us belongs the Hereafter and the first [life]
So I have warned you of a Fire which is blazing
None will [enter to] burn therein except the most wretched one
Who had denied and turned away
But the righteous one will avoid it
[He] who gives [from] his wealth to purify himself

92.ar: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعۡمَةٖ تُجۡزَىٰٓ
92.en: And not [giving] for anyone who has [done him] a favor to be rewarded
But only seeking the countenance of his Lord, Most High
And he is going to be satisfied

93.en: And [by] the night when it covers with darkness
Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muhammad], nor has He detested [you]
And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life]
And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied
Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge
And He found you lost and guided [you]
And He found you poor and made [you] self-sufficient
So as for the orphan, do not oppress [him]
And as for the petitioner, do not repel [him]
But as for the favor of your Lord, report [it]

94.en: Did We not expand for you, [O Muhammad], your breast
And We removed from you your burden
Which had weighed upon your back
And raised high for you your repute
For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease
So when you have finished [your duties], then stand up [for worship]
And to your Lord direct [your] longing

95.en: By the fig and the olive

95.ar: لَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ فِيٓ أَحۡسَنِ تَقۡوِيمٖ
95.en: We have certainly created man in the best of stature
Then We return him to the lowest of the low

95.ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمۡ أَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُونٖ
95.en: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for they will have a reward uninterrupted
So what yet causes you to deny the Recompense
Is not Allah the most just of judges

96.en: Recite in the name of your Lord who created
Created man from a clinging substance
Recite, and your Lord is the most Generous
Taught man that which he knew not
Indeed, to your Lord is the return
Have you seen the one who forbids
Have you seen if he is upon guidance
Have you seen if he denies and turns away
Does he not know that Allah sees

96.ar: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمۡ يَنتَهِ لَنَسۡفَعَۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ
96.en: No! If he does not desist, We will surely drag him by the forelock
Then let him call his associates
We will call the angels of Hell
No! Do not obey him. But prostrate and draw near [to Allah]

97.en: Indeed, We sent the Qur'an down during the Night of Decree
And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree

97.ar: لَيۡلَةُ ٱلۡقَدۡرِ خَيۡرٞ مِّنۡ أَلۡفِ شَهۡرٖ
97.en: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months

97.ar: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذۡنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمۡرٖ
97.en: The angels and the Spirit descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter
Peace it is until the emergence of dawn

98.ar: لَمۡ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنۡ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأۡتِيَهُمُ ٱلۡبَيِّنَةُ
98.en: Those who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists were not to be parted [from misbelief] until there came to them clear evidence

98.ar: رَسُولٞ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ يَتۡلُواْ صُحُفٗا مُّطَهَّرَةٗ
98.en: A Messenger from Allah, reciting purified scriptures

98.ar: وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا جَآءَتۡهُمُ ٱلۡبَيِّنَةُ
98.en: Nor did those who were given the Scripture become divided until after there had come to them clear evidence

98.ar: وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓاْ إِلَّا لِيَعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤۡتُواْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَۚ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ ٱلۡقَيِّمَةِ
98.en: And they were not commanded except to worship Allah, [being] sincere to Him in religion, inclining to truth, and to establish prayer and to give zakah. And that is the correct religion

98.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنۡ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ فِي نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآۚ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمۡ شَرُّ ٱلۡبَرِيَّةِ
98.en: Indeed, they who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists will be in the fire of Hell, abiding eternally therein. Those are the worst of creatures

98.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمۡ خَيۡرُ ٱلۡبَرِيَّةِ
98.en: Indeed, they who have believed and done righteous deeds - those are the best of creatures

98.ar: جَزَآؤُهُمۡ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ جَنَّـٰتُ عَدۡنٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدٗاۖ رَّضِيَ ٱللَّهُ عَنۡهُمۡ وَرَضُواْ عَنۡهُۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنۡ خَشِيَ رَبَّهُۥ
98.en: Their reward with Allah will be gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever, Allah being pleased with them and they with Him. That is for whoever has feared his Lord

99.en: When the earth is shaken with its [final] earthquake
And the earth discharges its burdens
And man says, "What is [wrong] with it
That Day, it will report its news
Because your Lord has commanded it

99.ar: يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَصۡدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشۡتَاتٗا لِّيُرَوۡاْ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ
99.en: That Day, the people will depart separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds

99.ar: فَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيۡرٗا يَرَهُۥ
99.en: So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it

99.ar: وَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٖ شَرّٗا يَرَهُۥ
99.en: And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it

100.en: And the producers of sparks [when] striking
Arriving thereby in the center collectively
Indeed mankind, to his Lord, is ungrateful
And indeed, he is to that a witness
And indeed he is, in love of wealth, intense

100.ar: ۞أَفَلَا يَعۡلَمُ إِذَا بُعۡثِرَ مَا فِي ٱلۡقُبُورِ
100.en: But does he not know that when the contents of the graves are scattered
And that within the breasts is obtained
Indeed, their Lord with them, that Day, is [fully] Acquainted

101.en: And what can make you know what is the Striking Calamity
It is the Day when people will be like moths, dispersed
And the mountains will be like wool, fluffed up
Then as for one whose scales are heavy [with good deeds]
He will be in a pleasant life
But as for one whose scales are light
His refuge will be an abyss
And what can make you know what that is
It is a Fire, intensely hot

102.en: No! You are going to know
Then no! You are going to know
No! If you only knew with knowledge of certainty
You will surely see the Hellfire
Then you will surely see it with the eye of certainty
Then you will surely be asked that Day about pleasure

103.ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلصَّبۡرِ
103.en: Except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience

104.en: Woe to every scorner and mocker
Who collects wealth and [continuously] counts it
He thinks that his wealth will make him immortal
No! He will surely be thrown into the Crusher
And what can make you know what is the Crusher
It is the fire of Allah, [eternally] fueled
Which mounts directed at the hearts
Indeed, Hellfire will be closed down upon them

105.ar: أَلَمۡ تَرَ كَيۡفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصۡحَٰبِ ٱلۡفِيلِ
105.en: Have you not considered, [O Muhammad], how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant
Did He not make their plan into misguidance
And He sent against them birds in flocks
Striking them with stones of hard clay
And He made them like eaten straw

106.en: For the accustomed security of the Quraysh
Their accustomed security [in] the caravan of winter and summer
Let them worship the Lord of this House

106.ar: ٱلَّذِيٓ أَطۡعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٖ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنۡ خَوۡفِۭ
106.en: Who has fed them, [saving them] from hunger and made them safe, [saving them] from fear

107.en: Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense
For that is the one who drives away the orphan
And does not encourage the feeding of the poor
So woe to those who pray
[But] who are heedless of their prayer
Those who make show [of their deeds]

108.en: Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muhammad], al-Kawthar
So pray to your Lord and sacrifice [to Him alone]
Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off

109.en: I do not worship what you worship
Nor are you worshippers of what I worship
Nor will I be a worshipper of what you worship
Nor will you be worshippers of what I worship
For you is your religion, and for me is my religion

110.en: When the victory of Allah has come and the conquest

110.ar: وَرَأَيۡتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدۡخُلُونَ فِي دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفۡوَاجٗا
110.en: And you see the people entering into the religion of Allah in multitudes

110.ar: فَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرۡهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابَۢا
110.en: Then exalt [Him] with praise of your Lord and ask forgiveness of Him. Indeed, He is ever Accepting of repentance

111.en: May the hands of Abu Lahab be ruined, and ruined is he

111.ar: مَآ أَغۡنَىٰ عَنۡهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ
111.en: His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained
He will [enter to] burn in a Fire of [blazing] flame
And his wife [as well] - the carrier of firewood
Around her neck is a rope of [twisted] fiber

112.en: He neither begets nor is born
Nor is there to Him any equivalent

113.en: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak
From the evil of that which He created
And from the evil of darkness when it settles
And from the evil of the blowers in knots
And from the evil of an envier when he envies

114.en: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind
From the evil of the retreating whisperer
Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind
From among the jinn and mankind
